_reconciliation: Every entry here is reconciled field-for-field against MuAPI's own GET /api/v1/models response, recorded in src/lib/models/catalog/muapi-live-catalog.json, and against the shipped model definitions in src/lib/models/definitions/. This file is the BOOTSTRAP fallback used when the live provider fetch fails, and src/lib/models/registry.js merges it OVER the local definition (`resolvedSpec.dynamicPricing ?? localDef...` does not skip an explicit `false`). A wrong pricing mode here therefore silently overrides a correct definition on the exact code path that runs during a provider outage.

This entry previously declared dynamicPricing=false with estimateEndpoint=null and an invented strategy:'FLAT', which made the bootstrap fallback path try to flat-bill a dynamically priced model.
